implemented: Immutable segmented accounting archive, durable quota reservations and verified restart.
Original baseline, cash/inventory, cumulative flows/fees/external costs, losses and insolvency retained.
Incremental created-at activity windows, overlap and archived-ID deduplication; no settlement-date watermark.
Strict local cost receipt reader and atomic explicit-declaration writer; missing costs stay null.
Optional original-JSON-bound broker accrual coverage, exact OTHER/reference/cost links, no second subtraction.
Current coverage separated from closed historical coverage; source-authenticity claim remains false.
Paginated complete record export and independent arithmetic/integrity reconstruction.

real_account_telemetry.reason: No account/activity access or real expense/accrual documents supplied for this task.

limitations: Archive retention is finite. Serialized quota excludes SQLite/WAL/filesystem overhead; active state has a separate cap.
Failed commits can consume reserved quota. Reservations and evidence are not silently purged.
A cost contradicting a sealed prefix latches ECONOMIC_RESTATEMENT_REQUIRED; automatic historical restatement is not implemented.
Receipt producer accepts supplied declarations; it does not connect to actual billing or broker statements.
Hashes, JSON-pointer bindings and arithmetic verify local documentary consistency, not external authenticity or completeness of an unseen source.
Broker accrual linkage requires category OTHER and matching coverage/document reference. Posted-vs-pending reclassification needs reconciliation/restatement.
Current uncovered tail is never represented as covered. Closed proof applies only to its explicit compared interval.
Whole-prefix performance materialization has strict count/byte limits; exceeding them produces WAIT and leaves paginated export available.
Benchmark uses one synthetic position, zero reported activities and an in-memory Store; it is not market latency or production capacity evidence.
These tests do not establish readiness level 4 or a net trading advantage. Observed causal data, reconciled actual costs/NAV and paired motor/Ridge/control evidence remain necessary.
